subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers ask the contributor to rebase and prove this PR, or adopt the same narrow fix in a new maintainer branch?
rationale: The PR is assigned, dirty, proof-gated, and targets stale paths; automation cannot decide whether to keep working this contributor branch or replace it with a maintainer-owned fix.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor move the fingerprint/cache-ownership check into `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update active tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Maintainer adopts the fix
options.body: A maintainer can open a fresh narrow PR against current main if the bug is urgent or the contributor branch remains stale.

options.title: Close after no response
options.body: If no rebase or proof arrives after maintainer follow-up, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor move the fingerprint/cache-ownership check into `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update active tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the current live assignee and is the best available owner for deciding contributor rework versus maintainer adoption.
